description: The bar chart, titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Stream,” visually compares the inference runtime (in seconds) of “Our Joint Framework” against several large language models (LLMs) — specifically ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude — under streaming conditions. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at 50-second intervals. The horizontal axis lists the models being compared. A legend in the upper left indicates that “Our Joint Framework” is represented by a dark green bar, while “LLM Models” are shown in light blue. Notably, only one green bar is displayed — labeled “77” — corresponding to “Our Joint Framework,” which appears to be a single integrated system rather than a model per se. In contrast, four light blue bars represent individual LLMs: ChatGPT (190 seconds), DeepSeek (365 seconds), LLaMA (172 seconds), and Claude (243 seconds). The chart clearly illustrates that “Our Joint Framework” achieves significantly lower runtime (77 seconds) compared to all listed LLMs, with DeepSeek being the slowest at 365 seconds. The bars are arranged in increasing order of runtime from left to right, emphasizing the performance advantage of the proposed framework. No error bars or confidence intervals are shown, and the values are explicitly labeled atop each bar for clarity. The chart’s tilted perspective is purely stylistic and does not affect the data interpretation.
